overview_description.description: Piramidal Termoplasticos Ltda is a distributor of resins, working with a variety of brands in the market. The company has been in operation for over 30 years, establishing a strong presence in the national market. Piramidal Termoplasticos Ltda is known for its agile delivery and incomparable know-how in the field of resin distribution. The company also places a strong emphasis on innovation, constantly seeking new ways to improve and expand its services. In addition to its core business of resin distribution, Piramidal Termoplasticos Ltda also focuses on sustainability and circular economy, reflecting its commitment to environmental responsibility.
